consent.title: Learn from my work
consent.body: Authorize private app and window metadata, your workflow markers, successful ERP queries and completed JR browser downloads. Only action categories and timestamps from real events are saved, never query arguments, returned data, file names or addresses. Records stay private on this computer; aggregated summaries may be sent to the company AI. No page contents, forms, passwords or documents are collected. An observed action does not prove a complete business routine.

dataNotice.title: Data use notice
dataNotice.intro: This notice explains two separate authorizations: using a selected excerpt to propose a company note, and opting into private work learning. Acknowledging this notice does not grant either authorization.
dataNotice.collectedBody: Company notes use only the excerpt you explicitly authorize. Work learning records application/window metadata and workflow milestones only after opt-in. It does not collect page contents, forms, credentials or continuous screenshots.
dataNotice.purposeBody: Help you recall validated knowledge and identify possible automations. Private learning is not used to rank employees or evaluate performance.
dataNotice.whoBody: Conversations and workflow records stay private by default. Only the reviewed note and authorized source excerpt can be shared with the chosen audience. Restricted search requires ERP authorization.
dataNotice.blockedBody: Vault secrets are redacted before processing. Do not include sensitive personal data in excerpts or workflow names. Filters add protection; review remains required.
dataNotice.retentionBody: Raw activity samples expire within 48 hours and private insights within 90 days. Historic conversation queues are not replayed automatically. Shared notes keep approved content and version history.
dataNotice.providerBody: Only explicitly authorized excerpts are sent through the company backend to the AI provider. Automatic work suggestions use aggregated data. Authorizing analysis is separate from authorizing sharing.
dataNotice.pauseBody: Private work learning starts after opt-in. Pausing stops collection until you resume. You can also disable collection. Nothing is published to the Brain automatically.
dataNotice.failed: Could not record this right now. The notice will appear again the next time you open the app.
